hypothesis: A sparse outcome-aware next-touch progression auxiliary objective can improve Candidate-E's shared temporal representation toward useful trajectory quality while preserving human imitation behavior. Candidate I is not a recovery router and is not a Candidate-H retry.

human_indexes.holdout_policy: hash may be verified before training; holdout samples may not be evaluated until every development smoke and evidence-preflight check passes

progression_auxiliary.head: affine_96_to_2_plus_softmax
progression_auxiliary.runtime_role: training_only; omit progression head from runtime-model.json; no action-routing change
progression_auxiliary.initialization: independent numpy.default_rng(1337); normal weight scale sqrt(2/96), shape 96x2; zero bias; must not consume the human-model RNG stream
progression_auxiliary.optimizer: separate Adam moments and separate auxiliary step counter
progression_auxiliary.sampling: epoch N uses deterministic permutation of all 119184 train fingerprints with seed 1337 + N; consume first 14336 without replacement
progression_auxiliary.schedule: one auxiliary update after each 100 completed human optimizer updates; Candidate-E has 5675 human batches/epoch, therefore exactly 56 auxiliary updates/epoch; fail closed if that cardinality is not reproduced

development_smoke.failure_rule: any development smoke or evidence-preflight failure rejects Candidate I before sealed holdout and before Promotion-v5; no retry or post-outcome tuning under this contract

final_evaluation.sealed_human_holdout: evaluate exactly once only after every development smoke/preflight gate passes
final_evaluation.decision_rule: any blocking gate failure rejects Candidate I; production pointers remain unchanged unless the complete existing promotion sequence later authorizes promotion

prohibitions: no Candidate-H retry or reuse of Candidate-H outcome to tune this contract
no change to Promotion-v5 sources, thresholds or policy
no class/role reweighting or outcome jitter
no runtime progression router or hand-coded progression controller
no hyperparameter search after Candidate-I outcomes
